text: 当前共有 20 个活跃事件。要点包括: Sources: Anthropic expects to generate $100B+ in annualized revenue this year, up from $65B as of July, as it moves ahead with its IPO amid the AI safety debate (New York Times); 长鑫存储据报在北京第二座晶圆厂规划3D NAND研发线; 弗吉尼亚州长签署第22号行政令，限制数据中心扩张并成立AI工作组; London-based AI infrastructure startup Nscale files for a US IPO, reports H1 2026 revenue up 1,252% YoY to $140.6M, with a net loss of $1.02B, up from $368.9M (Jordan Novet/CNBC); A new kind of AI model from a ChatGPT inventor is thrilling developers。
